speaker: Patient
text: 51-year-old woman. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis. The patient's 11-year history of chronic cough with copious thick, purulent sputum and recurrent "bronchitis" in a non-smoker is classic for this condition.
